race.comment: TIME TO COMMIT (5) looks well placed after racing on the speed and fighting on strongly for third over 1400m at Scone last start. This looks slightly easier and she can take this out. CHEATING LILIBET (6) has fought on for fifth at her past couple of starts and may be looking for more ground than 1000m. She gets her chance to bounce back into the top 3 with the extra 300m on offer here. Stick with her. TICKLE MY TOSEN (11) has been safely held in 2 runs since a break, finishing sixth at Kempsey last time out, but he should be nearing peak fitness now. He drops 4.5kg, and is ready to put his best hoof forward in this. SURPASSER (2) won as the favourite at a recent Mendooran picnic meeting, and despite rising in weight, he can repeat the dose, especially with Braith Nock in the saddle. SET TO PROPHET (1) has been consistent without winning, settling well back before finishing fourth at Coffs Harbour over 1318m last week. Each way all day.
